rows.text: "Before these seven pots of incense kneel countless dancers from all over the stars, who are getting madder by the day. They prostrate themselves before the meeting hall, and sing and pray to the 13th self-strangler - there are already 13 of them. The dancers will lie prone before God, pleading to know their end after the cosmic dance ends."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: "Here's a talisman about your fate. If you don't believe this type of thing, just treat it as a famous rumor of the cosmos."
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: A talisman stained with blood from an unknown source is placed before you... You regard it contemptuously and remain completely unimpressed. In your opinion, there is no such thing as fate...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe

rows.text: Deep down inside, you are tempted...
rows.speaker: Simulated Universe
